title: Is selling an AI version of your face to this microdrama startup the future of Hollywood?
summary: An actor has licensed his face to a microdrama startup — in a trend that's already popular in China. Experts question the long-term consequences if this becomes a trend in Hollywood, too.
llm_summary: A Hollywood actor has just licensed his likeness to a micro‑drama startup that creates short, AI‑generated videos using his face, a practice already common in China. While the technology promises cheap, on‑demand content, industry experts warn it could upend traditional casting, raise deep copyright and consent issues, and blur the line between an actor’s performance and a digital replica.
